sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This AI Incident Response Policy establishes the framework for detecting, reporting, and mitigating AI-related incidents within {system_name} operated by {org_name}. This policy applies to all components within the system boundary defined as {boundary} and ensures the protection of data including {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. AI Incident Response and Escalation

questions.prompt: How does the organization define an AI-specific incident (e.g., model drift, adversarial attack, bias failure)?
What is the defined escalation path from detection to executive notification?
Who are the designated members of the AI Incident Response Team?

sections.body: The organization manages AI incidents based on the following definition: {incident_definition}. Upon detection of an incident within {system_name}, the response is managed by {response_team} following the established escalation workflow: {escalation_workflow}.
